description: Call this when the user asks how public bitcoin-treasury stocks (MSTR/Strategy, XXI/Twenty One, MPJPY/Metaplanet, ASST/Strive) trade versus the bitcoin they hold. Returns a live mNAV scoreboard with three lenses: grossMNav (market cap ÷ BTC held; below 1.0 means the stock trades under the value of its bitcoin), evMNav (enterprise / fully diluted), and netMNav (CEBE, after senior claims). Also bps, cebeBps, and amplification. CEBE/EV are pending where senior-claims figures are not yet sourced. Educational market data, not investment advice.
name: get_treasuries
